meta.title: HSK 3.0 Level 3 — Chinese to English
meta.subtitle: 949 words · recall the meaning and pinyin
meta.desc: Shown the characters, recall the English meanings and the pinyin. The official HSK 3.0 Level 3 vocabulary — the 2021 standard, not the older HSK 2.0 syllabus. Every card carries the simplified form, the traditional form, pinyin, bopomofo, the measure word where the word takes one, and the full range of English translations rather than a single gloss. Traditional characters are shown at half strength, and are omitted entirely where they are identical to the simplified — 407 of the 949 words. The official list has 973 rows and this deck has 949 cards; the difference is duplication rather than anything left out. The syllabus lists a character again wherever it introduces a new sense, and a Folio card shows every sense a word has, so a word is carded at the level it first appears — 17 of this level's words are in the Level 1 or Level 2 deck instead. Where the syllabus lists a character twice at the SAME level it has two readings to learn, and it gets one card showing both, with the senses grouped under the reading they belong to. Word list: the official HSK 3.0 (2021) syllabus. Definitions, readings and measure words: CC-CEDICT (CC BY-SA 4.0).
